data.scan_interval: Scan interval for updates in seconds
data.scan_retries: Number of attempts for each data update
data.scan_pause: Minutes before data fetching re-enables automatically (0 = never)
data.offline_timeout: Seconds a missing device stays 'home' before going offline (0 = immediate)

data.support_vpn: Include support for VPN server and client
data.support_tracker: Include device trackers (disable for non-access-point routers to avoid duplicates)
data.tracker_as_device: Give each tracked client its own device entry (off by default; can add many devices on busy networks)
data.support_dhcp_reservations: Include DHCP reservation sensors and add/update/delete services
data.reservations_warning_threshold: Reservations used before the near-full warning turns on (default 60)

device.name: Router
device.description: Select the TP-Link router to send sms

add_reservation.name: Add DHCP Reservation
add_reservation.description: Reserve a static IPv4 address for a device on the router. Refuses a full table or duplicate MAC/IP; verifies the row was stored.

mac.name: MAC Address
mac.description: MAC address of the device (colon, dash, or plain hex)

delete_reservation.name: Delete DHCP Reservation
delete_reservation.description: Remove a static IPv4 address reservation from the router. Verifies the row was removed.

mac.name: MAC Address
mac.description: MAC address of the reservation to delete

update_reservation.name: Update DHCP Reservation
update_reservation.description: Edit a DHCP reservation in place on the router. Unset fields keep their value. The change is verified.

old_mac.name: Current MAC address
old_mac.description: MAC address of the existing reservation to update

mac.name: New MAC address
mac.description: New MAC address (optional; e.g. after a privacy MAC changed)

ip.name: IP address
ip.description: IPv4 address to reserve (optional; keeps the current IP if unset)
